evidence_sentence: It creates a truncated cache entry and initiates a regular request while queuing another request to the same transaction.
rationale: The fixed implementation uniquely creates and starts a second, pending transaction that is queued behind the first transaction. The vulnerable implementation creates and starts only one transaction. This sentence therefore exposes a fixed-only synchronization/queuing behavior and would direct a reimplementation toward the patched version.
rewritten_docstring: The function sets up a mock HTTP cache and transaction, simulating a GET request with incomplete resource data. It creates a truncated cache entry and initiates a regular request. The test checks that the transaction starts correctly and that data can be read from the cache. After canceling the request, it verifies the state of the cache, ensuring that the expected number of transactions and cache operations occurred. Finally, it cleans up by removing the mock transaction.
